rachel (PM): Quick thread to finalize Optimize Toolkit MVP & launch gates: batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts. Need owners, minimal acceptance, and rollback rules.

owen (Eng): Agreed. MVP = Recommendation API + opt-in toggle + decision path w/ p95 <=50ms. Blockers: cache invalidation hooks and model-variant routing.

tara (ML): Eval signals: concordance, perplexity jump, hallucination classifier. Default concordance 93% (tenant-overridable). I'll ship a nightly harness and baseline numbers.

sam (Solutions): SE ask: per-tenant opt-in, audit trail, and a short rationale in the response: e.g. "why: save ~2x tokens, concordance -4%". Provide 2 curl examples.

vince (SRE): Ops constraints: 5% canary initially, automated rollback if fallback >5% for 10m, logs retention 90d, and a kill-switch env var. Need staging smoke tests to run harness before rollout.

hannah (ProductOps): I'll own runbook/comms. Rollout plan: alpha opt-in -> 5% canary -> 25% -> GA. I'll collect acceptance criteria into a PR.

rachel (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: infra: routing + cache hooks; quality: nightly eval harness + baselines; observability: eval webhook + per-tenant metrics + audit logs; API: eval_threshold configurable + "why" in responses; ops: 5% canary, automated rollback rule, runbook written; SE: migration guide + 2 curl samples.

owen (Eng): I'll add perf scripts and perf regression guard: quant path must not increase serving latency >15% vs baseline.

tara (ML): Will share baselines by Friday. Note: for long-context customers we should flag quant risk separately.

sam (Solutions): For regulated tenants default to disable quant recs and require explicit opt-in.

vince (SRE): deploy-bot: create canary template please.

deploy-bot: Created canary plan template at /infra/canary-plans/optimize-toolkit.json

rachel (PM): Owners: Owen = eng + perf, Tara = eval harness, Vince = rollback automation, Hannah = runbook/comms, Sam = SE materials. Next: Owen to drop RFC with API shape Wed; Tara to publish baselines. Keep short updates here. Thanks!
